title: Arrival
synopsis: A linguist works to understand visitors from another world. Language, memory, and the experience of time shape a quiet story about human connection and first contact.

title: Interstellar
synopsis: A former pilot leaves his children to join a mission through a wormhole in search of a home for humanity. Space exploration meets family bonds, sacrifice, and the effects of time.

title: Blade Runner 2049
synopsis: A replicant officer investigates a discovery that could change the relationship between manufactured humans and their creators. A futuristic detective story about identity, loneliness, memory, and belonging.

title: Dune
synopsis: A young heir arrives on a desert planet whose valuable resource makes it the center of imperial conflict. Political betrayal, ecology, prophecy, and survival drive a sweeping science fiction adventure.

title: Dune: Part Two
synopsis: Paul Atreides lives among the Fremen while pursuing revenge against the rulers who destroyed his family. Desert warfare, religious power, and the consequences of leadership shape the struggle.

title: Tenet
synopsis: An operative enters an international conspiracy involving objects and people moving backward through time. Espionage, temporal puzzles, and large action sequences overlap.

title: Everything Everywhere All at Once
synopsis: A struggling laundromat owner encounters alternate versions of her life while trying to protect her family. A multiverse adventure connects absurd comedy, martial arts, regret, and mother-daughter relationships.

title: Parasite
synopsis: A financially struggling family gradually finds work in a wealthy household. Their increasingly entangled lives expose class divisions through dark comedy, deception, and escalating tension.

title: Whiplash
synopsis: An ambitious young jazz drummer studies under a demanding instructor whose methods become increasingly abusive. Musical performance becomes a contest over excellence, obsession, and the cost of approval.

title: Her
synopsis: A lonely man develops a romantic relationship with an intelligent operating system. An intimate speculative drama explores technology, emotional dependence, companionship, and changing forms of connection.

title: Ex Machina
synopsis: A programmer visits a reclusive inventor to evaluate an artificial intelligence housed in a humanlike robot. Conversations inside an isolated estate become a psychological contest over consciousness and control.

title: The Martian
synopsis: An astronaut stranded on Mars uses science and resourcefulness to survive while people on Earth organize a rescue. A space survival story balances practical problem solving, humor, and teamwork.

title: Annihilation
synopsis: A biologist joins an expedition into a mysterious region where living organisms change in unsettling ways. An atmospheric journey connects alien ecology, identity, grief, and self-destruction.

title: Moonlight
synopsis: Three chapters follow a boy growing up in Miami as he discovers his identity and navigates difficult relationships. A quiet coming-of-age drama about masculinity, tenderness, sexuality, and belonging.

title: Get Out
synopsis: A young Black man visits his white girlfriend's family and notices increasingly disturbing behavior. A social horror mystery turns an uncomfortable weekend into a struggle for survival and autonomy.

title: Us
synopsis: A family's seaside vacation is interrupted by strangers who look exactly like them. A home invasion grows into a disturbing story about doubles, identity, and inequality.

title: Nope
synopsis: Siblings running a horse ranch notice an unexplained presence in the sky. They attempt to document it while confronting danger, spectacle, and the desire to turn extraordinary events into images.

title: The Lighthouse
synopsis: Two lighthouse keepers work on an isolated island as storms, suspicion, and strange experiences erode their relationship. A claustrophobic period story about power, isolation, and unreliable perception.

title: The Witch
synopsis: A family living beside a remote New England forest faces frightening events after leaving its settlement. Religious anxiety, suspicion, and folklore create a slow period horror story.

title: Midsommar
synopsis: A grieving woman accompanies friends to a remote Swedish community's midsummer celebration. Bright daylight and communal rituals frame a disturbing story about relationships, belonging, and manipulation.

title: Hereditary
synopsis: After the death of a family matriarch, relatives struggle with grief and increasingly disturbing events. Family conflict, inherited secrets, and supernatural dread converge.

title: The Grand Budapest Hotel
synopsis: A hotel concierge and his young colleague become caught in a dispute over an inheritance and a stolen painting. A meticulously styled comic adventure reflects on friendship and a disappearing European world.

title: The French Dispatch
synopsis: Journalists at an American magazine in a fictional French city assemble stories for an issue. An anthology of art, politics, food, and eccentric characters celebrates reporting and storytelling.

title: Asteroid City
synopsis: Visitors at a desert astronomy convention experience an unexpected event. A story within a theatrical production explores grief, performance, curiosity, and people trying to make sense of their lives.

title: The Shape of Water
synopsis: A cleaner working at a government laboratory forms a bond with an amphibious captive. A romantic fantasy connects outsiders, secrecy, institutional violence, and the possibility of communication across difference.

title: Inside Out
synopsis: The emotions inside a girl's mind try to help her adapt after her family moves to a new city. An animated adventure connects memory, sadness, joy, and growing up.

title: Inside Out 2
synopsis: A teenager's familiar emotions encounter new arrivals as she faces the pressures of adolescence. An animated story about anxiety, identity, friendship, and changing ideas of the self.

title: Soul
synopsis: A jazz musician finds himself separated from ordinary life just as a major opportunity arrives. An animated fantasy questions purpose, ambition, and the value of everyday experiences.

title: Coco
synopsis: A boy who dreams of becoming a musician crosses into the world of the dead. Music, family history, memory, and remembrance guide his journey home.

title: Moana
synopsis: A young islander sails across the ocean to help her community and restore a disrupted natural balance. An animated musical adventure about navigation, responsibility, and discovering a path of her own.

title: Frozen
synopsis: A young woman searches for her sister after magical powers leave their kingdom trapped in winter. An animated musical about fear, sisterhood, isolation, and love.

title: Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse
synopsis: Teenager Miles Morales gains spider powers and meets heroes from other dimensions. A visually inventive animated adventure about mentorship, family expectations, and becoming one's own kind of hero.

title: Spider-Man: Across the Spider-Verse
synopsis: Miles Morales encounters a network of Spider-People while confronting rules about how their stories should unfold. A multiverse adventure examines responsibility, identity, and the pressure of inherited expectations.

title: Paddington
synopsis: A polite bear from Peru travels to London in search of a home and is taken in by a family. Gentle comedy and small adventures explore kindness, hospitality, and adjusting to an unfamiliar city.

title: Paddington 2
synopsis: Paddington hopes to buy a special present but becomes entangled in a theft. A warm comic adventure follows friendship, community, trust, and the effects of small acts of kindness.

title: The Wild Robot
synopsis: A robot stranded on an island learns to live among wild animals and cares for an orphaned gosling. An animated story connects parenthood, adaptation, nature, and unexpected community.

title: Zootopia
synopsis: A rabbit police officer teams up with a fox to investigate disappearances in a city of mammals. An animated detective adventure explores prejudice, ambition, and institutional assumptions.

title: Your Name
synopsis: Two teenagers living in different places begin switching bodies and leaving messages for each other. A romantic animated fantasy intertwines identity, memory, distance, and time.

title: Weathering with You
synopsis: A teenage runaway in a rainy Tokyo meets a girl with an unusual connection to the weather. A romantic fantasy links personal choices, economic hardship, and environmental change.

title: Suzume
synopsis: A teenager travels across Japan closing mysterious doors connected to disasters. An animated road adventure explores grief, memory, and learning to live after loss.

title: The Boy and the Heron
synopsis: A boy mourning his mother follows a strange heron into an unfamiliar world. An animated fantasy explores family change, loss, creation, and the temptation to escape reality.

title: A Silent Voice
synopsis: A former bully tries to reconnect with a deaf classmate and confront the harm he caused. An animated drama about guilt, isolation, disability, forgiveness, and learning to communicate.

title: The Tale of the Princess Kaguya
wiki: The Tale of the Princess Kaguya
synopsis: A tiny girl discovered in a bamboo stalk grows into a young woman whose family seeks a noble life for her. A hand-drawn folktale about freedom, social expectations, and impermanence.

title: The Wind Rises
synopsis: A young man pursues his dream of designing aircraft amid social upheaval and impending war. An animated historical drama considers creativity, responsibility, work, and love.

title: Past Lives
synopsis: Childhood friends reconnect across different countries and stages of adulthood. A restrained romantic drama considers migration, alternate lives, memory, and the choices that shape relationships.

title: Aftersun
synopsis: A woman reflects on a childhood holiday with her father through memories and recorded images. A quiet drama explores affection, distance, and the difficulty of understanding a parent.

title: Portrait of a Lady on Fire
wiki: Portrait of a Lady on Fire
synopsis: A painter arrives on an isolated island to create a portrait of a woman who resists being painted. A period romance examines looking, memory, artistic collaboration, and constrained lives.

title: Drive My Car
synopsis: A theater director works on a production while spending time with a reserved young chauffeur. Conversations, performance, and long journeys become a way to approach grief and unspoken relationships.

title: The Worst Person in the World
wiki: The Worst Person in the World (film)
synopsis: A young woman moves through changing relationships and career ambitions in Oslo. A bittersweet romantic drama examines uncertainty, growing older, and the pressure to choose a life.

title: Perfect Days
synopsis: A man cleaning public toilets in Tokyo finds rhythm in work, music, reading, and small encounters. A quiet observational drama about routine, solitude, memory, and everyday attention.

title: Minari
synopsis: A Korean American family starts a farm in Arkansas while adjusting to uncertain work and a new home. A family drama explores migration, generational relationships, ambition, and resilience.

title: Roma
synopsis: A domestic worker cares for a family in Mexico City during a period of personal and political upheaval. An intimate historical drama follows labor, family, social class, and unequal forms of care.

title: The Farewell
synopsis: A family gathers in China while withholding a serious diagnosis from its elderly matriarch. A bittersweet drama explores migration, cultural differences, family duty, and collective decisions about truth.

title: Little Women
synopsis: Four sisters pursue different hopes for work, art, marriage, and independence in nineteenth-century America. A period family drama about creativity, money, ambition, and changing relationships.

title: Marriage Story
synopsis: A theater director and an actor separate while trying to remain involved parents. An intimate drama follows love, resentment, legal conflict, and the practical difficulty of ending a shared life.

title: Lady Bird
synopsis: A teenager in Sacramento dreams of leaving home while clashing with her mother. A coming-of-age comedy-drama about class, friendship, ambition, and the complicated affection between parents and children.

title: Brooklyn
synopsis: A young Irish immigrant builds a life in New York but finds herself drawn back toward home. A period romance examines belonging, homesickness, independence, and choosing between possible futures.

title: Before Midnight
synopsis: A couple on holiday in Greece talk through the tensions of their long relationship. An intimate conversational drama about parenting, compromise, memory, and maintaining love over time.

title: La La Land
synopsis: An aspiring actor and a jazz musician fall in love while pursuing careers in Los Angeles. A musical romance considers ambition, artistic work, compromise, and the paths people choose.

title: Sing Street
synopsis: A teenager forms a band while navigating school, family tensions, and a new romantic interest in Dublin. Music becomes a route toward self-expression, friendship, and imagining a different future.

title: Sound of Metal
synopsis: A drummer faces a major change in his life when he begins losing his hearing. A drama about identity, disability, community, and the effort to accept uncertainty.

title: The Holdovers
synopsis: A teacher, a student, and a school cook remain at a boarding school during the winter holiday. Their uneasy company develops into a story about grief, loneliness, class, and unexpected connection.

title: Knives Out
synopsis: A detective investigates the death of a wealthy crime novelist while relatives compete over his legacy. An ensemble mystery mixes family secrets, social tension, and shifting accounts of what happened.

title: Glass Onion: A Knives Out Mystery
wiki: Glass Onion: A Knives Out Mystery
synopsis: A detective joins a wealthy host and his circle on a private island for a mystery game. An ensemble whodunit explores deception, status, influence, and competing loyalties.

title: The Nice Guys
synopsis: Two mismatched investigators search for a missing woman in 1970s Los Angeles. A comic detective story combines conspiracies, reluctant partnership, slapstick, and an increasingly tangled case.

title: The Big Short
synopsis: Investors notice problems in the American housing market before a financial crisis. A satirical financial drama examines incentives, institutional failures, speculation, and the distance between profit and its consequences.

title: Spotlight
synopsis: A newspaper team investigates allegations of abuse and institutional protection in Boston. A procedural drama follows reporting, evidence gathering, persistence, and the difficulty of challenging established power.

title: Oppenheimer
synopsis: A physicist leads work on the atomic bomb and later faces political scrutiny. A historical drama examines scientific ambition, state power, responsibility, and the consequences of technological achievement.

title: Dunkirk
synopsis: Soldiers, civilian sailors, and pilots experience the evacuation of Allied forces from Dunkirk. Interwoven timelines turn a wartime rescue into a tense story about survival and collective effort.
Two soldiers cross dangerous territory to deliver a message during the First World War. An urgent journey through changing landscapes focuses on duty, survival, and the human scale of war.

title: The Imitation Game
synopsis: A mathematician and his colleagues work to break wartime codes while he faces discrimination and secrecy. A historical drama connects intelligence work, social isolation, and the costs of institutional prejudice.

title: Ford v Ferrari
synopsis: A designer and a racing driver develop a car to challenge Ferrari at Le Mans. A motorsport drama about craftsmanship, corporate control, competition, and a demanding friendship.

title: Mad Max: Fury Road
synopsis: A drifter joins a rebel driver escaping a tyrant across a desert wasteland. A fast-moving post-apocalyptic chase centers on survival, solidarity, exploitation, and resistance.

title: Furiosa: A Mad Max Saga
synopsis: A young woman grows up amid rival powers in a violent desert wasteland. A post-apocalyptic action story follows survival, captivity, revenge, and the struggle to find a way home.

title: John Wick
synopsis: A retired assassin returns to a criminal underworld after a personal loss. A revenge thriller emphasizes precise action, professional codes, and escalating conflict.

title: John Wick: Chapter 4
synopsis: An assassin seeks a route out of the powerful organization pursuing him. A globe-spanning action thriller follows alliances, elaborate confrontations, and the personal cost of survival.

title: The Raid 2
synopsis: A police officer goes undercover inside a criminal organization while rival factions compete for control. An action crime thriller combines infiltration, divided loyalties, and extended martial-arts confrontations.

title: Mission: Impossible - Fallout
synopsis: An intelligence team races to recover stolen nuclear material while facing distrust and shifting loyalties. An espionage action film builds around chases, infiltration, and high-stakes practical missions.

title: Top Gun: Maverick
synopsis: An experienced naval pilot returns to train younger aviators for a dangerous mission. An aviation drama connects technical skill, mentorship, grief, and taking responsibility for others.

title: Logan
synopsis: An aging mutant protects a young girl while caring for a former mentor. A somber superhero road story focuses on exhaustion, found family, mortality, and the hope of passing something on.

title: The Batman
synopsis: A young vigilante investigates a series of killings that reveal corruption in Gotham. A rain-soaked detective thriller emphasizes clues, institutional decay, vengeance, and the question of what protection means.

title: Guardians of the Galaxy
synopsis: A group of misfits becomes entangled in a conflict over a powerful object. A comic space adventure follows unlikely friendship, found family, and learning to act together.

title: Black Panther
synopsis: A new king faces a challenger whose history forces his nation to confront its relationship with the wider world. A superhero adventure connects inheritance, isolation, political responsibility, and identity.

title: Avengers: Endgame
synopsis: Surviving heroes search for a way to respond to a devastating defeat. A superhero ensemble adventure brings together grief, sacrifice, time travel, and the conclusion of long-running relationships.

title: Edge of Tomorrow
synopsis: A reluctant soldier repeatedly relives a battle against an alien invasion. A science fiction action story uses a time loop to explore learning, cooperation, and changing the course of an apparently lost conflict.

title: Predestination
synopsis: A time-traveling agent follows a case that becomes entangled with a stranger's unusual life story. A compact science fiction mystery explores identity, causality, and temporal paradoxes.

title: Coherence
synopsis: Friends at a dinner party experience strange events during the passage of a comet. A low-budget science fiction thriller turns an ordinary home into a puzzle about alternate realities and trust.

title: Upgrade
synopsis: A man injured in an attack receives an experimental implant that changes his physical abilities. A science fiction revenge thriller examines bodily autonomy, technological dependence, and control.

title: Palm Springs
synopsis: Two wedding guests become trapped in a repeating day. A romantic comedy uses a time loop to explore detachment, responsibility, and the possibility of choosing connection.

title: About Time
synopsis: A young man discovers he can revisit moments in his life and tries to improve his relationships. A romantic family story considers time, loss, ordinary happiness, and the limits of control.

title: The Lobster
synopsis: In a society that requires adults to find partners, a recently single man enters a hotel with unsettling rules. A darkly comic dystopia examines conformity, romance, and social control.

title: Poor Things
synopsis: A young woman created through an unusual scientific experiment leaves her confined world to explore. A fantastical journey examines autonomy, curiosity, social conventions, and the experience of learning.

title: The Favourite
synopsis: Two women compete for influence over Queen Anne in an eighteenth-century court. A darkly comic period drama follows ambition, manipulation, dependency, and shifting personal loyalties.

title: The Menu
synopsis: Guests travel to an exclusive restaurant on a remote island for a meticulously planned meal. A dark satire turns fine dining into a confrontation over privilege, artistic work, and consumption.

title: Barbie
synopsis: A doll leaves her seemingly perfect world and encounters the realities of human society. A comic fantasy explores identity, gender expectations, self-awareness, and the tension between ideals and everyday life.

title: The Substance
synopsis: An entertainer uses a mysterious treatment that promises a younger version of herself. A body-horror satire examines beauty standards, aging, ambition, and the treatment of women's bodies as products.

title: Challengers
synopsis: A tennis player turned coach navigates a charged history with two competitors. A sports drama uses shifting timelines and relationships to examine ambition, desire, rivalry, and control.

title: Civil War
synopsis: Journalists travel through a fractured United States to document an armed conflict. A tense road story examines witnessing violence, professional distance, and the instability of everyday life during war.

title: Anora
synopsis: A young sex worker becomes involved with the son of a wealthy Russian family. An unpredictable romantic comedy-drama explores money, work, power, and the collision between personal hopes and family influence.

title: A Real Pain
synopsis: Two cousins travel through Poland to honor their grandmother while navigating their difficult relationship. A bittersweet journey explores family history, grief, inherited trauma, and contrasting ways of coping.

title: The Brutalist
synopsis: A Hungarian architect rebuilds his life in postwar America and works with a wealthy patron. An expansive historical drama explores migration, artistic ambition, dependency, and the relationship between creation and power.

title: Flow
synopsis: A cat displaced by a flood travels with other animals on a small boat. A largely wordless animated adventure explores cooperation, adaptation, trust, and survival in a changing natural world.

title: Robot Dreams
synopsis: A lonely dog in New York builds a robot companion and experiences an unexpected separation. A wordless animated story considers friendship, memory, longing, and the ways relationships change.
